Asset type: editorial cover for the introductory article of Arai Hû's open-source software engineering blog, reused unchanged in English, Brazilian Portuguese and Spanish. Create one polished wide landscape illustration, 16:9 composition, ideally 2048 by 1152 pixels. Palette: very dark ink navy #07111f, deep blue #173b72, warm off-white #f2f0e6, small electric lime #c7ff4a accents. Strong contrast, quiet confident composition, no neon glow, no glossy 3D, no stock-photo look. Keep the main cloud and linked modules in the central safe area so the composition survives social crops. Opaque background. No words, letters, numbers, captions, branding text, logos, watermarks, people, mascots, national flags, or product screenshots. This is a distinct editorial illustration, not a redesigned company logo.
